title: Four-storey commercial building, Katugastota Road, Kandy
highlights: Four floors: retail below, offices or rentals above
Suits investors looking for rental income
description:
A four-storey commercial building on Katugastota Road, one of the main routes in and out of Kandy.

The ground floor suits a shop or showroom, with the upper floors usable as offices, a clinic, a tuition space or rental units.

Ask on WhatsApp for photos, the floor plan and a live video viewing.
